title: The residue hunt: frame-invariant structure exists; the hierarchy lives in a coboundary direction
claim_one_line: THE RESIDUE HUNT (door 3 after the crossing-design ruling; 3 staged agents, adversarial check HOLDS with B936's 92 internal checks re-run first): the four canonical frames assembled for the first time (G = H^1 = (Z/2)^2 as {I, D_c, D, D_cD}; conjugation = D_c cross-identified three ways; the D2D-vs-D_cD naming trap flagged) and two exact theorems banked -- THE FRAME-BLIND VACUUM BLOCK (the Hermitian pairing on the 3-dim vacuum charge block W3 is literally the same rational matrix for every canonical frame; mechanism: W3's 9-index support meets zero canonical sign-flips; MB12 bite: D2/D2D flip 5 of the 9 and land in Q(sqrt3129)) and THE PARITY LAW (det-ratio_full27 = (-1)^flips, exhaustive over all sixteen X^tau structures, with exact block-orthogonal factorization on G) -- BUT the reopening condition is NOT met: every value-bearing functional is G-variant (one pure sign character, zero invariant Fourier content) or uncomputed at the canonical frames, and the genuinely mass-ratio-shaped content (lambda, CCC, HIER, v_g^2, the flip masses) is banked only at (I, D2) where D2 IS NOT IN G -- its class is (0,0), a coboundary partner of I: THE HIERARCHY IS CARRIED BY A COBOUNDARY DIRECTION INVISIBLE TO H^1 (the canonical frames all see the degenerate (x+3)^3), so the frame-relativity blocking the mass lane is the within-class coboundary choice, not G-relativity. The mass-ratio lane STAYS CLOSED; the named deciding computation: the atom-line H-norm pipeline swept across the class-(0,0) coboundary coset (does HIER persist; is any symmetric function of v_g^2 coboundary-invariant) -- registered with its blocker. The arc also closes the crossing-design record: R1 PARTIAL (Re spent, Im kind-partnerless), the kind adjudication closing every coupling lane, the fourth crossing's value-comparison form CANNOT SEAL under R1+R5 -- the register working as designed.
